Despite repeated requests by AP , the army hasn’t provided details about the investigation or a timeline for when it could be completed. Rights groups say Israel rarely holds troops accountable for killing Palestinians, pointing to long investigations that rarely lead to prosecution . As global outrage over the August 25, 2025, strikes grew, the Israeli military said that in addition to taking out the camera, six of those killed were linked to Hamas, without providing evidence. items.title: New video shows BJP MLA’s daughter slapping woman SI in Karnataka temple
items.summary: Days after a Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MLA’s daughter was booked for assaulting an on-duty police officer, CCTV footage of the altercation between the sub-inspector and the woman at a Mandya temple has surfaced. The incident took place on August 12 at the Arathi Ukkada temple in Srirangapatna taluk during Bhima Amavasya celebrations. Sub-Inspector Savitha B Patil, who is attached to the Mandya Women’s Police Station, had been deployed at the temple for crowd management and security. The woman involved, Aishwarya, is the daughter of Tumakuru Rural BJP MLA B Suresh Gowda and is married to police officer Gautham, an Assistant Commissioner of Police. According to Savitha’s complaint, Aishwarya arrived at the temple and sought to enter the sanctum sanctorum despite the heavy rush. The officer allegedly asked her to wait for a few minutes to avoid inconvenience to other devotees. Aishwarya is then alleged to have questioned why she was being stopped and identified herself as the MLA’s daughter.
